scope: Foundation FileHandle read retained; replace Data.Iterator only with synchronous data.withUnsafeBytes iteration. No POSIX/SystemPackage/error adapters.
verification: Every stdout/stderr byte must match preserved independent references; outputs preserved and identical content hardlinked within each phase only after timing and exact verification.
followup: Any individual PRIMARY paired elapsed or RSS increase >5% triggers one separate fixed follow-up for that configuration: six pairs for file/stdin, twenty for startup. No recursive follow-up and no pooling or deletion.
measurement_separation: Run Mac and native ARM64 Linux timing separately; no builds/tests/profiling/hash audits during timed phases. x86 uses separate host.
historical_results: Copied fixtures/references with exact hashes; prior results are untouched and not pooled.
